title: Bookomi 'Books for Breakfast' @ Soho House London — Eric Ries on Incorruptible
summary: Eric joins Richard Kilgarriff's long-running 'Books for Breakfast' series at Soho House London on the second day of his UK book tour. Bookomi has hosted authors in this format at Soho House clubs since 2011; Soho House members RSVP through the club network.
blockquote: Books for Breakfast — Bookomi's flagship series of author breakfast events, running at Soho House clubs since 2011.
